title: La reproduction des animaux
through_line: On va voir naître trois petits, chacun à sa façon.

blocks.vo_line: Les animaux ne font pas tous leurs petits de la même façon.
blocks.shot: A calm farmyard in southern Cameroon with red laterite earth and an oil palm behind: a hen on the left, a goat in the middle, and a snake coiled on warm sand on the right, each one quietly in its own corner. Keep the lower left corner calm and uncluttered.

blocks.vo_line: Les ovipares pondent des œufs : la poule, le poisson, l’escargot.
blocks.shot: A hen settling on a small nest of pale eggs, a fish in a shallow pool beside her and a snail on a leaf, warm morning light. Keep the lower left corner calm and uncluttered.

blocks.vo_line: Les vivipares donnent directement naissance aux petits : la chèvre, la vache.
blocks.shot: A goat standing beside her newborn kid on red earth, a cow with her calf a little further back, soft warm light. Keep the lower left corner calm and uncluttered.

blocks.vo_line: Les ovovivipares gardent leurs œufs dans le ventre : la vipère.
blocks.shot: A snake coiled on warm sand, a soft glow inside her body showing small eggs, one tiny snake just emerging beside her. Keep the lower left corner calm and uncluttered.
